items.title: FCA warns public over burleysfox.com clone firm
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued a warning regarding an unauthorised website mimicking genuine firm Burley Fox Limited.

items.title: Bomb alert at Calais-Fréthun disrupts Eurostar services
items.summary: Security checks at a northern French station halt high-speed rail traffic, raising familiar questions for travel insurers over disruption cover.

items.title: Intact Insurance plans regulated London branch for European specialty business
items.summary: Intact Insurance is combining its UK and European Specialty Lines operations under Intact Insurance (Europe) and aims to open a regulated UK branch from January 2027.

items.title: UK and European school bomb threats expose commercial insurance cover gap
items.summary: Recent mass email bomb threats across the UK and Europe have exposed significant gaps in non-damage business interruption and terrorism insurance cover.

items.title: Zurich posts record P&C premiums as Beazley acquisition completes
items.summary: Zurich Insurance Group reported US$42.1 billion in nine-month property and casualty gross written premiums as its acquisition of Beazley closed.

items.title: Gallagher's Derek Henry on the integration challenge facing Irish broker buyers
items.summary: Following years of private equity-backed acquisitions in Ireland's broker market, firms face the operational test of combining multiple businesses into single entities.
